title: Secure hosts and restore-point remote helper launches
description: Mutable remote PowerShell helpers in apps/hosts.ps1 and apps/managerestorepoints.ps1 can be executed without integrity verification. Remove policy overrides, pin immutable HTTPS sources and independent SHA-256 digests before any request, verify exact bytes before launch, and fail closed while pins are absent. Preserve action arguments, consent, shortcuts, and native outcomes when a release is configured. OpenSpec change: openspec/changes/secure-hosts-and-restorepoint-launches. Spec: openspec/changes/secure-hosts-and-restorepoint-launches/specs/remote-helper-launch-security/spec.md.
acceptance_criteria: Offline tests cover missing or malformed pins, mutable URLs, unavailable source, changed bytes, rejected payload non-execution, exact argument forwarding, and child exit status. Production performs no request or fallback while release pins are absent.
notes: Implemented the shared immutable-source trust gate with unset production pins. Offline trust tests passed with 41 assertions; execution-policy launcher checks passed with 24 assertions; syntax passed under PowerShell 7 and Windows PowerShell 5.1; OpenSpec validation passed. No helper source was fetched or executed, no restore-point operation ran, and no package manager was invoked.
close_reason: Completed the trust gate, fail-closed wrappers, linked OpenSpec artifacts, offline tests, and focused validation.

title: Review and configure remote helper release pins
description: The Hosts File Manager and Manage Restore Points wrappers intentionally fail closed because their production release pins are empty. Review approved upstream releases, verify exact HTTPS URLs with full commit IDs, independently reproduce SHA-256 digests from trusted artifacts, and configure pins only after independent review. Keep pins empty if evidence or approval is missing. Do not use mutable URLs, fallbacks, or policy overrides. Run offline tests and only authorized Windows checks; do not infer live behavior from fake executor tests.
acceptance_criteria: Every configured pin maps to the expected repository and script path, a full immutable commit, and an independently verified digest. Missing or rejected pins fail before network or setup. Live helper behavior is reported only after authorized Windows validation.
